svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Mint Tilt $0 mark, v5
svg.desc: The matched two-point tag rotates eight degrees as one form, preserving equal lobe dimensions and spacing. A soft mint body carries a smaller complementary-green dollar beside a larger deep-green zero. The right and bottom lobe segments are exact reflections across x equals y, with equal six-unit-radius openings at reflected positions. Original, unadopted concept with editable lettering.
